mapping_coordinate_convention: qualified forward target coordinates are 0-based half-open

annotation_categories.TE: base class in SINE, LINE, LTR, DNA, RC, RETROPOSON
annotation_categories.UNKNOWN: base class UNKNOWN or class/family field containing ?
annotation_categories.NONTE: known non-TE base classes SIMPLE_REPEAT, LOW_COMPLEXITY, SATELLITE, RNA, SNRNA, SCRNA, SRPRNA, TRNA, RRNA
annotation_categories.UNRECOGNIZED: any other base class; retained separately and never treated as known non-TE

overlap_definition.annotation_union: Merge overlapping annotation intervals within each category and target chromosome before measuring overlap
overlap_definition.parallel_categories: TE, UNKNOWN, NONTE and UNRECOGNIZED are measured independently; categories are not forced into a winner when source annotations overlap
overlap_definition.ge50: category union overlap_bp / qualified target interval length >= 0.50
overlap_definition.ge80: category union overlap_bp / qualified target interval length >= 0.80
overlap_definition.failed_mapping_rows: Retain every non-qualified mapping outcome with mapping status and empty annotation fields; do not treat it as zero-support evidence
overlap_definition.denominator: All source TP/FP/FN/TN rows remain the denominator; qualified rows are reported as a separate subset
